scope: A1 additional synthetic regressions and static trust/version/coverage review

findings.qualification: TESTED_OFFLINE within finite grammar; no independent real-corpus certification
findings.new_defect: Known identity with fabricated literal in guillemets or single quotes could pass with quote=null. Unbalanced or second quotes could be omitted too.
findings.first_evaluation: FAIL; eight quote-related failures and one spaced-abbreviation failure
findings.remediation: es-bibliography-v3 preserves paired quotations, marks incomplete/additional quotations unresolved, and recognizes spaced A . y . S .; checker gate remains closed
findings.remaining_limit: Finite Spanish grammar. Court/chamber require explicit labels; arbitrary natural-language attribution, unknown notation and semantic correctness require human review. Additional unresolved quote markers are not counted as additional bibliographic references.

findings.evidence: Rejects valid signature from unconfigured issuer, same issuer ID signed with wrong key, configured key under another authorized actor, URL host/credentials/port mismatch, expiry and fixture promotion; signed full document and original hash rechecked
findings.remaining_limit: No official government signer was verified. Registry is privileged host configuration; a compromised host/verifier can grant false authority. Host must protect keys, verifier authorization, source validation and rights policy.

findings.evidence: Out-of-order versions, explicit current head, unpublished subsequent candidate, caller-map mutation, historical snapshot access, foreign-study rejection and unrelated private ambiguity tested
findings.remaining_limit: publishVersion is a trusted host operation, not authenticated as a remote service; no production persistence or role policy is supplied by the Junta CLI.

findings.qualification: TESTED_OFFLINE configurable budgets, mock model windows and complete coverage
findings.evidence: Existing 150K/300K budget tests plus additional complete prose/reference payload and blocked-audit state tests pass. Oversized input never invokes auditor or reaches HUMAN_REVIEW_PENDING.
findings.remaining_limit: Model account windows, tokenizer bounds, provider behavior, quality and billing were not established through inference; no automatic fragmentation.

findings.reason: Synthetic disposable Ed25519 test signers and mocked provider metadata do not prove real official provenance, exhaustive bibliography or production host security.

build_and_smoke.reason: Consolidated root validation uses a new phase2 smoke request ID; see phase2 final report.

policy.prior_run_compatibility: Prior version-2 IDs have different input hashes and require a new request ID; no cached model replay or historical overwrite.
